Stage 1 is an NMOS pair with a resistor tail (~6 uA) and diode loads plus cross-coupled PMOS. Its gain (~6) stays linear and fast. Stage 2 converts ±60 mV to near-full IREF current at node x (~6 fF). Two inverters give rail-to-rail drive into 50 fF. Supply current is ~16 uA, about 29 uW. Inverter-1 trip is matched to the mirror-diode Vgs to keep offset low."}

```python
PARAMS = {
    "W_in":  (1.0,   0.42, 4.0),     # nfet input pair W (L=0.15)
    "R_tail":(60e3,  25e3, 200e3),   # stage-1 tail resistor -> I_A
    "W_ld":  (0.84,  0.42, 3.0),     # pfet diode load W
    "W_x":   (0.42,  0.42, 2.0),     # pfet cross-coupled W (clamped < 0.7*W_ld)
    "L_ld":  (0.5,   0.3,  1.0),     # load L (diode and cross)
    "W_pb":  (2.0,   0.6,  6.0),     # stage-2 pfet pair W
    "L_pb":  (0.15,  0.15, 0.4),     # stage-2 pfet pair L
    "L_mn":  (1.0,   0.3,  2.0),     # stage-2 nfet mirror L (W derived to match inv1 trip)
    "Wp_i1": (1.0,   0.42, 3.0),     # inverter-1 pfet W (nfet 0.42/0.15)
    "Wn_i2": (1.5,   0.42, 4.0),     # output inverter nfet W
    "Wp_i2": (3.0,   0.84, 8.0),     # output inverter pfet W
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    Lin = 0.15
    UT_ = 0.02585

    def bis(f, lo, hi, n=45):
        flo = f(lo)
        for _ in range(n):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            fm = f(mid)
            if (fm > 0) == (flo > 0):
                lo, flo = mid, fm
            else:
                hi = mid
        return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

    def vgs_for(dev, W, L, I, vds, vsb=0.0):
        return bis(lambda v: lut.op(dev, W, L, v, vds, vsb)["Id"] - I, 0.05, 1.8)

    # ---------------- stage 1: resistor-tail NMOS pair ----------------
    R = p["R_tail"]
    W_in = p["W_in"]
    def gI(I):
        vs = I * R
        return vgs_for("n", W_in, Lin, I / 2, 0.4, vs) + vs - vcm
    I_A = bis(gI, 0.2e-6, 30e-6, 35)
    Vs = I_A * R

    # loads: diode + cross-coupled (k<1, no hysteresis)
    W_ld, L_ld = p["W_ld"], p["L_ld"]
    W_x = min(p["W_x"], 0.7 * W_ld)
    W_x = max(W_x, 0.42) if 0.7 * W_ld >= 0.42 else 0.0
    def side(v):
        I = lut.op("p", W_ld, L_ld, v, v)["Id"]
        if W_x > 0:
            I += lut.op("p", W_x, L_ld, v, v)["Id"]
        return I - I_A / 2
    vsg_ld = bis(side, 0.3, 1.8)
    va = vdd - vsg_ld
    o1 = lut.op("n", W_in, Lin, vcm - Vs, max(va - Vs, 0.05), Vs)
    od = lut.op("p", W_ld, L_ld, vsg_ld, vsg_ld)
    ox = lut.op("p", W_x, L_ld, vsg_ld, vsg_ld) if W_x > 0 else {"gm": 0, "gds": 0, "cgg": 0, "Id": 0}
    g_load = od["gm"] - ox["gm"] + od["gds"] + ox["gds"] + o1["gds"]
    A_A = o1["gm"] / max(g_load, 1e-9)

    # ---------------- stage 2: PMOS pair, tail = IREF itself ----------------
    W_pb, L_pb = p["W_pb"], p["L_pb"]
    vsg_b = vgs_for("p", W_pb, L_pb, iref / 2, 0.8)
    v_ibias = va + vsg_b
    ob = lut.op("p", W_pb, L_pb, vsg_b, 0.8)

    # inverter-1 trip
    Wn1, Ln1, Wp1 = 0.42, 0.15, p["Wp_i1"]
    trip = bis(lambda v: lut.op("n", Wn1, Ln1, v, 0.9)["Id"]
               - lut.op("p", Wp1, 0.15, vdd - v, 0.9)["Id"], 0.2, 1.6)

    # nfet mirror sized so diode Vgs at iref/2 == inverter-1 trip (low systematic offset)
    L_mn = p["L_mn"]
    Iu = lut.op("n", 1.0, L_mn, trip, trip)["Id"]
    W_mn = min(max(1.0 * (iref / 2) / max(Iu, 1e-12), 0.42), 60.0)
    vgs_mn = vgs_for("n", W_mn, L_mn, iref / 2, 0.8)
    om = lut.op("n", W_mn, L_mn, vgs_mn, vgs_mn)
    A_B = ob["gm"] / max(ob["gds"] + om["gds"], 1e-12)

    # ---------------- timing estimate ----------------
    C_A = od["cgg"] + ox["cgg"] * 1.5 + 0.6 * ob["cgg"] + 0.3 * o1["cgg"] + 0.8e-15
    tau_A = C_A / max(od["gm"] - ox["gm"], 1e-9)
    t_A = tau_A * math.log(2)
    vidB = min(A_A * vod, 0.25)
    iX = iref * math.tanh(vidB / (2 * 1.35 * UT_))
    oi1n = lut.op("n", Wn1, Ln1, trip, 0.9)
    oi1p = lut.op("p", Wp1, 0.15, vdd - trip, 0.9)
    C_X = oi1n["cgg"] + oi1p["cgg"] + 0.3 * ob["cgg"] + 0.3 * om["cgg"] + 1.0e-15
    dX = max(abs(trip - vgs_mn), 0.0) + 0.4
    t_B = C_X * dX / max(iX, 1e-9)
    Wn2, Wp2 = p["Wn_i2"], p["Wp_i2"]
    In1 = lut.op("n", Wn1, 0.15, 1.5, 0.9)["Id"]
    Ip1 = lut.op("p", Wp1, 0.15, 1.5, 0.9)["Id"]
    C_y = lut.op("n", Wn2, 0.15, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"] + lut.op("p", Wp2, 0.15, 0.9, 0.9)["cgg"] + 1e-15
    t_i1 = C_y * 0.9 / max(min(In1, Ip1), 1e-9)
    In2 = lut.op("n", Wn2, 0.15, 1.8, 0.9)["Id"]
    Ip2 = lut.op("p", Wp2, 0.15, 1.8, 0.9)["Id"]
    t_i2 = (cl + 3e-15) * 0.9 / max(min(In2, Ip2), 1e-9)
    tpd = t_A + t_B + t_i1 + t_i2

    power = vdd * (iref + I_A) + 0.2e-6
    offset = abs(trip - vgs_mn) / max(A_A * A_B, 1.0) + 0.3e-3

    # ---------------- netlist ----------------
    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("M1", "a1", "vinp", "s", "vss", "nfet", W_in, Lin)
    n.M("M2", "a2", "vinn", "s", "vss", "nfet", W_in, Lin)
    n.R("RT", "s", "vss", R)
    n.M("M3", "a1", "a1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W_ld, L_ld)
    n.M("M4", "a2", "a2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W_ld, L_ld)
    if W_x > 0:
        n.M("M5", "a1", "a2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W_x, L_ld)
        n.M("M6", "a2", "a1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", W_x, L_ld)
    # stage 2: IREF is the tail current of the PMOS pair (source/well = ibias)
    n.M("MB1", "x", "a1", "ibias", "ibias", "pfet", W_pb, L_pb)
    n.M("MB2", "d2", "a2", "ibias", "ibias", "pfet", W_pb, L_pb)
    n.M("MN1", "d2", "d2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W_mn, L_mn)
    n.M("MN2", "x", "d2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W_mn, L_mn)
    # inverter chain (x high -> y low -> vout high)
    n.M("MI1", "y", "x", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp1, 0.15)
    n.M("MI2", "y", "x", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn1, Ln1)
    n.M("MI3", "vout", "y", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp2, 0.15)
    n.M("MI4", "vout", "y", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn2, 0.15)

    return n, {
        "tpd": tpd,
        "power": power,
        "offset": offset,
        "polarity_ok": 1,
        "I_A": I_A, "A_A": A_A, "A_B": A_B, "v_a": va, "v_ibias": v_ibias,
        "trip_inv1": trip, "vgs_mirror": vgs_mn, "t_A": t_A, "t_B": t_B,
        "t_inv": t_i1 + t_i2,
    }
```
